name: El Laberinto de Azem
source:
Azem is an architect.  By himself he is a fairly normal person, throwing himself clumsily, but his mind holds a secret that nobody knows and that allows him to carry out extraordinary achievements: you , who are able to think and decide for him  and whom Azem calls ' Fire' .

Once again, Azem is in a mess. A Cleric has selected the brilliant architect to plan and build a certain mystical labyrinth in accordance with the precepts of the Faith ... and it is better to do it well, because those who contradict it tend to end badly.

Your task is to help him fulfill the assignment and, with it, avoid death. To achieve this, you must solve several puzzles that will reveal the way forward during the construction process. Solve the riddles, persuade the Cleric and Azem will live happily the rest of his days. He makes a mistake, and Azem will end up condemned.

[From [url=https://polybiak.itch.io/el-laberinto-de-azem] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿泽姆是一位建筑师。就他个人而言，他是一个相当正常的人，笨拙地投掷自己，但他的内心深处藏着一个无人知晓的秘密，这使他能够取得非凡的成就：你，能够为他思考和决定的人，被阿泽姆称为“火”。

阿泽姆再次陷入混乱。牧师挑选了一位杰出的建筑师，按照信仰的戒律来规划和建造某个神秘的迷宫……最好做得好，因为那些违背它的人往往会下场很糟糕。

你的任务是帮助他完成任务，并避免死亡。为了实现这一目标，你必须解决几个谜题，这些谜题将揭示构建过程中的前进方向。解开谜题，说服牧师，阿泽姆将幸福地度过余生。他犯了一个错误，阿泽姆最终将受到谴责。

[来自[url=https://polybiak.itch.io/el-laberinto-de-azem] itch.io[/url]]
